bias_variance_method: Relative screening heuristic across the tuned candidates: compare mean training and validation recall and their absolute gaps to the cohort medians. Lower-half training and validation scores suggest potential high bias; an above-median positive gap suggests potential high variance; above-median validation recall with an at-or-below-median gap suggests relatively better generalisation. Other patterns are mixed. The medians are cohort-relative indicators, not universal cutoffs or statistical proof.
